posts.cooked:
I guess if Orbo has that many necks, that explains how KNYFE added him to her body count. They were just NECKING.

“Ambuscade with Fanatic powers” - he’s called Solipsist, he is literally his own God, and he believes in himself.

I really want a golden age Haka panel, when they had no respect for Maori culture and were just treating him as a savage, where he just yells “HAKA IS STRONGEST THERE IS!!!”

Fanatic has enormous Charisma; she’s not interested in getting people to like her or even agree with her, but she’s great at aweing and terrifying people with no more than a self righteous lecture.

Taking the Dreamer to the domain of the Nightmare Weaver seems like a very very bad idea.

The big reason why intelligence counts against your powerset is magic; the more you know about how reality works, the less effective magic should be in your presence, because you know why it can’t possibly work. Science is power through knowledge, magic is power from lack of knowledge.
